body:
Android half of T-364 (the design of record; read it in full first — the orchestrator hands
you a copy). Sections 2 (wire), 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9 are the contract. The server half is being
built in parallel by another agent against the same design: code to the design, fake the API
in tests as the existing screens do, and do not wait for it. Everything is in `:core` and
`:shared` (commonMain); `:app` only if the Koin graph or a migration test needs it.

## Deliverables

* `:core`: `ListGuest(id, name, initials, locked, claimedBy, createdAt)` next to `ListMember`
  in `Expense.kt`; `guests` on the list DTO and `guestNames` (`guest_names`) on the pushed list
  row in `Dto.kt`; the five guest calls in `Api.kt`; `guestsJson` on `ListEntity` with a Room
  migration (and the `AppDbMigrationTest` workaround, see AGENTS.md); `Protocol.kt`
  `PROTOCOL_VERSION` 4 (floor unchanged). Decoding stays lenient (T-205: unknown keys ignored).
* `ExpenseMath` (`:core`): `aliasesOf(guests)`, `fold(expense, aliases)` (sum in cents, copy
  type / date / equal flags), used **before** `balancesFor`, `entryEffectCents`, `settle`,
  `spentTotals` and `formerMemberNumbers` everywhere. `ExpenseMathTest`: run the new `fold`
  group of `shared-test-cases/expense-arithmetic.json` (folded entries compared as wire maps,
  balances in order, total, settle), and property tests: sum-to-zero over folded entries for
  any alias map; empty aliases is identity; fold is idempotent.
* A participant-label resolver per the table in section 8, used by every screen; the frozen
  set and reason computed on stored keys per section 6.
* `ListPropsScreen`/`ListPropsViewModel`: the Guests section under "Shared with", ledgers only,
  exactly as section 8 (rows with outline badge, Rename inline, "Amounts locked" switch with its
  help line, "This is me", Remove disabled with the in-use reason while a live entry names the
  guest, "claimed by DP" / Unclaim, the Add guest field; read-only when closed; disabled with
  the voted hint while the viewer has voted).
* Overview create dialog (`OverviewViewModel` and its screen): the Guests section for the
  Ledger kind (dynamic name boxes, Add another, remove, hidden at 50, blanks dropped,
  `guest_names` on the creation row through `ListsRepository.create`, queued offline as the
  creation is today).
* `ExpenseDialog`/`ExpenseFormViewModel`: members and unclaimed guests as participants in
  roster order, guests marked; locked guests treated as voters are (fixed share, unselectable on
  a new entry; the T-196 seeding must not zero a locked guest's share). Transfers may name
  guests.
* `ExpenseListScreen`/`ExpenseListViewModel` rows and `BalancesScreen`: labels per the table;
  effect for the viewer's effective id; one balance row per effective id, guests marked,
  "amounts locked" line (its own string, not T-203's); Reimburse records with the guest's own
  id and is disabled for a locked guest. The post-join chooser: `InviteJoiner` navigates to the
  list with a `joined` flag; `ExpenseListScreen` consumes it once and opens "Are you one of
  these?" with a button per unclaimed guest and "No, I'm new" when the list is a ledger with
  unclaimed guests. The multi-account "Join with which account?" stays first.
* `ErrorText.kt`: `guest_not_found`, `guest_claimed`, `guest_in_use`, `invalid_guest_name`;
  `participant_frozen` wording names the participant via the label.
* Gating: guest controls, the create-dialog section and the chooser only when the account's
  `serverProtocol` ≥ 4; reading `guests` is not gated.
* Every new string in all ten `values*/strings.xml` (`en, de, fr, es, pt-BR, uk, ar, ja,
  zh-Hans, qaa`). The web agent adds the same English strings; `crossClient.test.ts` pairs by
  identical English, so take the English wording **verbatim from the design's section 8 and
  this ticket** and do not invent variants. If you need a string the design does not word,
  write it down in your commit message so the orchestrator can align the two clients.
* Any new class in the Koin graph goes into `CommonModules.kt` (or `PlatformModule.kt`);
  `KoinGraphTest` must pass.

## Tests

View-model and screen tests in `shared/src/androidUnitTest` for each screen change, the
chooser, the gating against a protocol-3 server, the migration, and the error strings; follow
the Robolectric pitfalls in AGENTS.md (`closeWhenIdle`, `runBlocking<Unit>`, qualifiers). A new
test must fail with its change reverted; say which you checked by mutation.

## Conventions

Run the Android stage the way `verify-all.sh` does (see the script); `cd android && ./gradlew
--stop` when done. Commit on your branch with `(T-nnn)` and the trailer `Co-Authored-By:
Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. Never touch gittoc, never push.
